projects.summary: Serves a Docusaurus site as an MCP server, so Claude, Cursor and other agents can search and read your docs.
A code review harness that people and AI agents run through the same commands. Models make the findings. The harness enforces the steps, independent verification and human sign-off.
Agent Skills for Claude Code and Codex: self-review, pull request review, working through review comments, and plain writing.
Playwright-based tests and evals for MCP servers, with an LLM judge. I'm its main author at Glean.
Narrated explainer videos from code. Each visual lines up with the word it belongs to, and terminal and browser captures come from real runs.
Eval-driven development for prompts. It runs test cases against an LLM judge, compares them to a baseline, and can fix regressions through Claude Code.
Ranks what most needs a maintainer's attention across their repos, from a scheduled GitHub Action with no server.

projects.label: fixturify-project
projects.summary: Builds real npm projects on disk for tests. I co-maintain it.
Runs your CLI as a subprocess against real files and captures the output, so CLI tests read like unit tests.
Keeps code samples in Markdown in sync with real source files that you can lint and test.
A release-it plugin that publishes every package in a workspace.
A jscodeshift codemod that moves Jest tests to Vitest.
A Python port of fixturify-project.
A health checkup for JavaScript projects, with output in SARIF. I wrote most of it.

projects.label: lint-todo
projects.summary: Turns existing lint violations into todos with due dates, so a large codebase can adopt a new rule without fixing everything first.
The linter for Ember and Handlebars templates. I was a maintainer and added its todo support.
Manages the lifecycle of async work in Ember objects so tests do not leak.
Runs axe accessibility audits inside Ember tests.
Lets Ember's test helpers wait for async operations to finish.
JavaScript tools for SARIF, the standard format for static analysis results.
